Extract one combination from a turf result

Source: R/order.R
extract_combination.Rd

Pulls the products of a single combination out of a turf() result as a character vector, ready to pass to order_products().

Usage

extract_combination(result, rank = 1)

Arguments

result

A data frame returned by turf().

rank

The rank of the combination to extract. Defaults to 1, the top combination.

Value

A character vector of products, in the order turf() returned them (descending solo reach).

See also

order_products() to order and score the extracted products.

Examples

result <- turf(
  am,
  colnames(am),
  num_products = 4,
  batch_size = 2,
  keep_n_at_batch = 10,
  num_return = 3
)
#> Searched 4,358 combinations: 2,653 regular and 1,705 swap, across 2 batches.
extract_combination(result)
#> [1] "southwind" "coi"       "lemon"     "may"      
extract_combination(result, rank = 2)
#> [1] "southwind" "coi"       "lemon"     "green"
